title: PRAY BEFORE YOUR FEET TOUCH THE GROUND – INSTANT MORNING PROTECTION
text: Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. There is somebody here tonight. God is about to do something. I feel the presence of God so strong. Before I even begin, I want you to lift your hands wherever you are right now. Whether you are watching on your phone, whether you are in this auditorium, whether you are in your room, whether you are driving, I want you to receive this word tonight because what God is about to release is not ordinary. This is not a motivational speech. This is not entertainment. This is the word of the living God. And I sense in my spirit that somebody connected to this broadcast, your life is about to change tonight. Not because of me, not because of any man, but because of the word that is coming. The Bible says in Isaiah 55 10-11, as the rain comes down and the snow from heaven, and returns not thither, but waters the earth and makes it bring forth and b that it may give seed to the swer and bread to the eater. So shall my word be that goes forth out of my mouth. It shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it. So, Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for this moment. I thank you for this gathering. I thank you for every soul that is connected, Lord. Let your word accomplish its purpose tonight. Let no one leave this place or this broadcast the same way they came in Jesus's mighty name. Somebody shout hallelujah. Hallelujah. >> Now, before I go into the word tonight, I want you to understand something. This message that I'm about to share is not ordinary. And I'm not saying this to hype you. I'm saying this because I know what the spirit of God is about to release. You see, there are certain dimensions of protection that most believers never walk in because they don't understand spiritual protocols. They love God. They are born again. They speak in tongues. They go to church. But they are constantly under attack. They are constantly battling one issue or the other. and they keep asking, "God, why me? Why is it always me?" And tonight, I want to show you something from scripture that will revolutionize your life. I want to show you the mystery of morning protection. I want to show you why the first moments of your day determine the trajectory of everything that follows. I want to show you why the devil is more interested in your mornings than any other time. And I want to arm you with the understanding and the prayer patterns that will cause you to live in a dimension of divine preservation that the enemy cannot penetrate. Are you ready to receive? Let me read to you from the book of Psalm 5. Psalm 5 and we will start from verse one down to verse three. The Bible says, "Give ear to my words, oh Lord. Consider my meditation. Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my king and my God. For unto thee will I pray. My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up. Did you hear that? David said, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, not in the afternoon, not in the evening, not when problems come, but in the morning before the day unfolds, before the challenges arise, before the enemy makes his move in the morning." And then he said something powerful. He said, "In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." The word direct there is the Hebrew word arak and it means to set in order to arrange to prepare like an army setting itself in battle array. So David is saying in the morning I arrange my prayers before you like a soldier arranging his weapons for battle and then I look up expecting you to respond. This is not casual prayer. This is strategic militant targeted prayer. This is prayer that understands times and seasons. This is prayer that recognizes that the morning is a battleground. And whoever wins the morning wins the day. Let me show you something else. Go with me to the book of Mark 1:35. The Bible says, "And in the morning rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed." Who is he? Jesus the son of God. The one who has all power in heaven and in earth. The one before whom demons tremble. The one who spoke and the storm obeyed. Even Jesus understood the mystery of the morning. He rose up a great while before day. Not when the sun was already up. Not when activities had begun, but before day. In the darkness, in the stillness. In the quiet hours when heaven is most accessible. If Jesus needed to pray in the morning, who are you to think you can skip it? Listen to me carefully. The enemy knows that if he can capture your morning, he can control your day. If he can dominate the first hours, he can dictate what happens in the remaining hours. This is why so many believers wake up feeling heavy. They wake up feeling tired even though they slept. They wake up with anxiety and fear. They wake up with bad news. They wake up with confusion because the enemy met them there. Before they could pray, before they could cover themselves, before they could build their spiritual defenses, the enemy was already at work. But tonight, that pattern is breaking. I declare over your life from this day forward, no morning attack shall prosper against you. No evil projection shall locate you at dawn. No witchcraft arrow shot in the night. Hours shall find its target in your life. You are covered by the blood of Jesus. Let me explain something to you. The morning is what I call the portal of the day. Every day has gates and the morning is the first gate. If you secure that gate, everything else flows properly. But if that gate is compromised, the enemy has access to everything that follows. In the book of Genesis chapter 19, when the angels came to deliver Lot from Sodom, do you know when they made their move? The Bible says in verse 15, "And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot." When did deliverance happen? In the morning, when did the rescue mission begin? At the arising of the morning. And in Exodus 14, when Israel was trapped between the Red Sea and Pharaoh's army, do you know when God intervened? The Bible says in verse 27, "And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea and the sea returned to his strength. When the morning appeared, when did the enemy drown?" When the morning appeared. The morning is significant. The morning is strategic. The morning is prophetic. This is why the enemy fights against your prayer life in the morning. This is why your sleep is heaviest when it's time to pray. This is why distractions come just when you about to seek God's face. This is why your alarm fails. This is why you oversleep. This is why you feel too tired. Because the enemy knows that if you pray before your feet touch the ground, he loses jurisdiction over your day. Are you hearing me? Somebody shout, "I will pray before my feet touch the ground." Now, let me show you the enemies that operate in the morning. Because if you're going to win this battle, you need to know who you're fighting. Number one, the spirit of delay. The spirit of delay operates strategically in the morning hours to cause you to waste time, miss opportunities, and lose divine appointments. That's why you woke up on time, but somehow everything went wrong. You couldn't find your keys. Traffic was unusually bad. Your meeting was cancelled at the last minute. The spirit of delay hadn't manipulated your morning. But I speak to somebody tonight, every morning delay assigned against your life is terminated now. Every schedule manipulation is cancelled. Every appointment sabotage is destroyed. From tomorrow, you will walk into your day with precision. You will meet the right people at the right time. Doors that were supposed to open will open. Opportunities that were supposed to come will come because delay has lost its power over your mornings. Number two, the spirit of confusion. This spirit attacks your mind in the morning to make you unfocused, unclear, and disoriented. That's why you have days where you feel like you are moving but not making progress. You're busy but not productive. You're working but not achieving. The spirit of confusion captured your morning and spread its influence throughout your day. But tonight, I decree clarity over your mornings. Your mind shall be sharp. YOUR THOUGHTS SHALL BE ORDERED. Your decision shall be sound. Confusion is bound in Jesus name. You shall think clearly. You shall plan effectively. You shall execute with precision. The spirit of confusion has no place in your life. Number three, the spirit of heaviness. Isaiah 61:3 talks about the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness. This spirit attacks you the moment you wake up. Before you even open your eyes, you feel a weight on your chest. You feel depressed. You feel anxious. You feel burdened. That's not natural tiredness. That's a spiritual attack. The spirit of heaviness trying to set the tone for your day with sorrow. But I prophesy to somebody, the garment of praise is upon you now. The spirit of heaviness is lifting. Depression is breaking. Anxiety is losing its grip. You shall wake up with joy. You shall rise with thanksgiving. Your morning shall be filled with praise. The spirit of heaviness is defeated. Number four, the spirit of accident and sudden destruction. This spirit operates in the morning to cause calamity, mishaps, and tragedy. That's why most accidents happen in the morning hours. That's why sudden bad news often comes in the morning. That's why the enemy waits until you on your way to work or school to strike. But I cover you tonight with the blood of Jesus. Every accident assigned against your morning commute is canled. Every sudden destruction planned against you is averted. Every trap set on your path is exposed and destroyed. You shall go out in safety. You shall come in in safety. No evil shall befall you. No plague shall come near your dwelling. Angels have been assigned to your mournings. They shall bear you up in their hands, lest you dash your foot against a stone. Number five, the spirit of bad news. 2 Kings chapter 19:35 tells us about the angel of the Lord who went out in the night and smoked the army of the Assyrians. And when Israel arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses. The enemies woke up to find themselves destroyed. But for the children of God, the morning brought good news. I decree over your life, your morning shall not bring bad news. You shall not wake up to sorrow. You shall not wake up to tragedy. You shall not wake up to death reports. Your morning shall bring testimonies. Your morning shall bring breakthroughs. Your morning shall bring favor reports. Every morning bad news assigned against you is intercepted by angels. Now let me teach you the protocol of morning protection because it's not enough to understand the problem. You need to know the solution. The first protocol is prayer before activity. Pray before your feet touch the ground. The moment you wake up, before you check your phone, before you brush your teeth, before you talk to anyone, before you step out of bed, pray. Cover yourself. Cover your household. Cover your day. Don't give the enemy a window. You see, the reason many believers are vulnerable is that they've created gaps. They wake up, grab their phones, scroll through social media, read the news, and by the time they pray, they've already absorbed the atmosphere of the world. They've already exposed themselves spiritually, but the protocol is prayer first. Always prayer first. The second protocol is the blood covering. Exodus 12. When death was passing through Egypt, what protected the Israelites? The blood on the doorposts. The death angel saw the blood and passed over. In the same way, when you apply the blood of Jesus over your morning, death passes over. Destruction passes over. Calamity passes over. The blood speaks for you. Hebrews 12 24 says the blood of Jesus speaks better things than the blood of Abel. When you plead the blood in the morning, it speaks on your behalf. It speaks protection. It speaks preservation. It speaks redemption. It speaks victory. So when you wake up, declare, I plead the blood of Jesus over my life. I plead the blood over my going out and my coming in. I plead the blood over my family. I plead the blood over my day. Let the blood speak for me. The third protocol is the declaration of God's word. Proverbs 18 21 says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue. What you speak in the morning creates your reality." If you wake up saying, "I feel like today is going to be a bad day," you just prophesied your own destruction. But if you wake up saying, "This is the day that the Lord has made. I will rejoice and be glad in it." You just prophesied your victory. Speak the word over your morning. Speak Psalm 91. Speak Psalm 23. Speak Isaiah 54-17. Speak Jeremiah 29 to 111. Let the word of God be the first thing on your lips. The fourth protocol is worship. When you worship in the morning, you create an atmosphere that demons cannot operate in. Worship displaces darkness. Worship invites the presence of God. Worship builds a hedge of protection around you. 2 Chronicles chapter 20. When Jehoshaphat faced an army he couldn't defeat, what did he do? He sent worshippers before the army. And as they began to worship, God set ambushments against the enemy. Worship activates angelic intervention. So when you wake up, worship, sing to the Lord. Magnify his name. Let praise fill your mouth before anything else. The fifth protocol is angelic dispatch. Psalm 91:11 says, "He shall give his angels charge over you to keep you in all your ways, but angels respond to the word of God." Psalm 103:20 says, "Angels excel in strength and hearken unto the voice of his word." When you speak God's word in the morning, you are dispatching angels to go before you and prepare your way. Declare, I dispatch angels to my workplace. I dispatch angels to my school. I dispatch angels to my root. I dispatch angels to my meetings. Go before me, angels of the Lord, and make crooked paths straight. Now, are you ready to pray? I want you to stand to your feet wherever you are. If you're driving, stay focused on the road, but let your spirit join this prayer. If you're lying down, sit up. This is not the time to be casual. We're about to enter into serious spiritual warfare. Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the revelation that has come tonight. I thank you for opening the eyes of your people to the mystery of morning protection. Now Lord, let the prayers we pray tonight become a template for our mornings. Let the fire that falls tonight be sustained in our lives in Jesus name. >> Now lift your voice and begin to pray like this. Father, I thank you for the gift of new mornings. I thank you that every morning represents a new opportunity, a new chance, a new beginning. Thank you Lord that you have not allowed me to be consumed. Thank you that your mercies are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness. Now pray this. Lord, I repent for every morning I wasted. I repent for every morning I skipped prayer. I repent for every morning I gave to social media instead of taught your presence. I repent for every morning I allowed the enemy to capture. Father, forgive me and restore what the enemy has stolen through my negligence. Now begin to declare from this day forward my mornings belong to the Lord. I dedicate the first fruits of my day to God. Before my feet touch the ground, my mouth shall be filled with prayer. Before my eyes fully open, my spirit shall be engaged in worship. No more morning casualness. No more morning negligence. I take authority over my mornings in Jesus' name. Now let's pray against morning attacks. Pray like this. Every spirit assigned to attack me in the morning, I bind you now in the name of Jesus. Every demon on assignment against my mornings, I command you to be paralyzed. Every witchcraft operation scheduled for my mornings, I CANCEL YOU BY THE BLOOD OF JESUS. Every satanic arrow shot in the night to meet me in the morning, I return you to sender. Every evil manipulation of my mornings, I overthrow you now. I shall not wake up to sorrow. I shall not wake up to tragedy. I shall not wake up to bad news. I shall not wake up to confusion. My mornings are secured in Jesus' name. Father, I plead the blood of Jesus over every morning of my life from now until the end of my days on earth. I plead the blood over my mornings. Let the blood speak protection. Let the blood speak preservation. Let the blood speak victory. Let the blood form a hedge around me that the enemy cannot penetrate. I decree that from tomorrow morning when the enemy comes against me, he shall find a wall of fire. He shall find a mountain of blood. He shall find an army of angels. He shall flee in seven directions. For it is written, the Lord shall cause my enemies that rise against me to be smitten before my face. Now pray for your household. Father, I cover my household in the morning. I cover my spouse. I cover my children. I cover my parents. I cover my siblings. Before they wake, the blood is speaking. Before their eyes open, protection is activated. No morning attack shall succeed against my family. We are covered. We are shielded. were preserved. Pray for your going out. Lord, I cover my going out in the morning. From the moment I step outside my door. I am under divine escort. Angels go before me. Angels surround me. Angels follow behind me. No accident on the road. No mishap in transit. No calamity on my way. I shall arrive at my destination in peace. I shall return home safely. Every trap set on my path is exposed and destroyed. Now begin to pray against the spirit of delay. I bind the spirit of delay in my mornings. I shall not be late to my destiny. I shall not miss my divine appointments. I shall not lose my opportunities. Everything meant to come to me shall come on time. Every meeting shall happen as scheduled. Every door shall open when I arrive. Delays bound. My mornings are ordered by the Lord. Pray against confusion. I bind the spirit of confusion. My mind is clear. My thoughts are ordered. I know what to do. I know where to go. I know what to say. I am not double-minded. I am not unstable. Clarity is my portion. Wisdom is my portion. Divine direction is my portion. Pray against heaviness. Spirit of heaviness, I reject you. You shall not set the tone for my day. I shall wake up with joy. I shall rise with strength. My morning shall be filled with praise. Depression, you are bound. Anxiety, you are bound. Fear, you are bound. I put on the garment of praise. I put on the oil of joy. I put on the spirit of gladness. Now pray this. Father, give me the grace to pray in the morning. Let my eyes open early. Let my spirit be alert. Let my body cooperate. Remove every hindrance to my morning prayers. Remove every distraction. Remove every spirit that causes oversleeping. I shall rise before the sun. I shall meet you before the day begins. Let every altar walking against my mornings be destroyed now. Every witchcraft pot cooking my destiny in the night to release its effects in the morning, I overthrow you by fire. Every evil covenant affecting my mornings, I break you by the blood of Jesus. Every ancestral curse that attacks family members in the morning, I nullify you in Jesus' name. My mornings are free. My mornings are blessed. My mornings are preserved. Now begin to make declarations over tomorrow morning. Specifically, tomorrow morning I shall wake up in victory. Tomorrow morning I shall rise with strength. Tomorrow morning, my body shall be healthy. Tomorrow morning, my mind shall be sharp. Tomorrow morning, my spirit shall be active. Tomorrow morning, the blood is already speaking. Tomorrow morning, angels are already on assignment. Tomorrow morning is secured in Jesus' name. Tomorrow morning, no bad news. Tomorrow morning, no tragedy. Tomorrow morning, no accidents. Tomorrow morning, no sickness. Tomorrow morning, no confusion. Tomorrow morning, favor shall speak. Tomorrow morning, blessings shall flow. Tomorrow morning, opportunities shall manifest. Whatever I need to accomplish, tomorrow I shall accomplish. Whoever I need to meet, I shall meet. Whatever doors need to open shall open. Tomorrow is my day of success. Tomorrow is my day of breakthrough. Tomorrow is my day of testimony. Now, let's go deeper. Let's pray for specific areas of your life that need morning protection for your career and workplace. Father, I cover my workplace with the blood of Jesus. Every morning I walk into that office, I walk in with authority. No office politics shall prevail against me. No enemy in the workplace shall prosper. No evil eye watching me shall succeed. I shall have favor with my superiors. I shall have peace with my colleagues. Promotion is coming to me. Increase is coming to me. My mornings at work are blessed for your business. Lord, I cover my business every morning. Every morning my doors open. Customers shall enter. Sales shall happen. Contracts shall be signed. Deals shall be closed. No morning of loss, no morning of failure. My business rises every morning. Profit is my portion. Expansion is my portion. My mornings in business are blessed for students. Father, I cover my school every morning. Every morning I enter that campus, I enter with excellence. My mind shall be sharp for learning. My memory shall retain what I study. No morning examination shall catch me off guard. No morning test shall fail me. I am the head and not the tail. I excel above my peers. My mornings in school are blessed. For those seeking employment, Lord, I cover my job. Search every morning. Every morning I apply. Let favor speak. Every morning I go for interviews. Let grace announce me. The right door shall open. The right opportunity shall manifest. No more rejection. No more waiting. My morning of employment breakthrough is here for those seeking marriage. Father, I cover my mornings regarding my man, rage, destiny. Every morning brings me closer to my spouse. No wrong connection in the morning. No counterfeit in the morning. The right person shall find me. The right person shall recognize me. My morning of marital settlement is coming. For those believing for children, Lord, I cover the mornings of our conception. Let the morning come when we shall receive good news. Let the morning come when the doctor shall say, "You are pregnant." Let the morning come when we shall hear the cry of our babies. Our wombs are blessed. Our mornings are fruitful for health challenges. Father, I cover my health. Every morning, every morning I wake up, sickness loses its grip. Every morning, healing flows. Every morning, my body gets stronger. No disease shall triumph in my mornings. No symptom shall persist through my mornings. I wake up healed. I wake up whole. I wake up in divine health. Now let's enter into warfare prayer. This is where we confronts the powers that operate in the morning hours. Lift your voice and pray. Every power assigned to kill me in the morning. Your assignment is terminated. I shall not die before my time. I shall fulfill my days. I shall complete my purpose. Death has no authority over my mornings. I decree long life and satisfied years. Every power stealing my virtue in THE MORNING. I RECOVER EVERYTHING YOU HAVE TAKEN. My strength is restored. My anointing is restored. My glory is restored. My health is restored. My finances are restored. Sevenfold restoration. Now every power sponsoring nightmares that affect my mornings, I destroy your operations. My sleep shall be peaceful. My dreams shall be prophetic. I shall not wake up from evil dreams. I shall wake up refreshed and strengthened. Every power using my mornings to cage my destiny. I break free now. I am not caged. I am not limited. I am not restricted. My destiny is unleashed. My purpose is activated. I rise into everything God has ordained for me. Every covenant entered by my ancestors that affects morning hours, I break it now. The blood of Jesus speaks against you. I am not under your jurisdiction. I am under the blood. I am under the covenant of grace. Your power is broken. Every ritual performed at evil altars to affect my mornings, I overturn that altar now. Let fire from heaven consume every sacrifice made against me. Let confusion scatter every gathering against my mornings. Their incantations are null. Their spells are void. I am covered by the most high. Now pray this prayer of angelic activation. Father, release your angels to watch over my mornings. Assign warrior angels to my bedroom. Assign guardian angels to my doorway. Assign protecting angels to my vehicle. Assign escorting angels to my path. Let the host of heaven surround me every morning. I speak to my angels. Go before me every morning and prepare my way. Remove obstacles from my path. Shut the mouths of lions waiting to devour me. Close the doors the enemy has opened against me. Open the doors God has ordained for me. Minister to me. Minister for me. minister around me. Father, let the angel of breakthrough visit me every morning. Let the angel of favor accompany me every morning. Let the angel of healing touch me. E very morning. Let the angel of provision supply me every morning. My mornings are filled with angelic activity. Now let's pray for the nations and for revival. Father, we pray for the mornings of nations. Every nation under demonic influence, let the morning of deliverance arise. Every nation under corrupt leadership, let the morning of change arise. Every nation under economic bondage, let the morning of prosperity arise. We pray for the church. Let the morning of awakening come. Let the morning of revival come. Let the morning of harvest come. Let the church rise from her slumber. Let the bride prepare for the bridegroom. We pray for souls, every soul asleep in sin. Let the morning of salvation come. Let the light of the gospel shine upon them. Let this be the morning of their rescue. Let this be the morning of their deliverance. Now, I want to speak some prophetic words over you. Receive this. I see somebody, you have been waking up tired. Every morning, you feel like you've been fighting in your sleep. Listen to me. Tonight marks the end of that cycle. The spirit that has been wrestling with you in the night IS BOUND. NOW from tomorrow you shall wake up refreshed. You shall wake up energized. The battle has been won. There is somebody else. Your mornings have been filled with bad news. It seems like every morning brings a new crisis, a new problem, a new challenge. The Lord says to tell you the cycle of morning troubles is over. Your mornings are turning around. From now, your morning shall bring testimonies. Your morning shall bring breakthroughs. Your morning shall bring answers to prayer. Someone here, you've been having dreams that leave you confused and disturbed. You wake up and you can't shake off the heaviness. The Lord is saying, "I am cleansing your dream life. From tonight, your dreams shall be from me. You shall receive direction in your dreams. You shall receive revelation in your dreams. You shall receive answers in your dreams. No more demonic interference. There's a woman here. You've been praying for conception and every month has been disappointment. The Lord says the morning of your joy is coming. Prepare the room. Prepare the clothes. Your baby is coming. This is your season of fruitfulness. There's a man here. You've been working hard, but nothing is working out. Every morning you go to work hoping things will change, but it's been the same struggle. The Lord says, "A morning of turnaround is approaching. Your labor shall not be in vain. Your sweat shall produce harvest. Promotion is coming. Increase is coming. Your morning of elevation is at hand." Someone here has been battling depression. Every morning feels like a mountain you have to climb. The Lord says, "I am lifting the burden. I am removing the weight. Joy is coming to you." Laughter is returning to your mouth. The spirit of heaviness is leaving. Receive the oil of joy now. Hide your prayers. The siege is over. Your mornings are redeemed. Your days are secured. Your destiny is preserved. Go now. And never forget, pray before your feet touch the ground in Jesus's mighty name. Amen. Shalom.
